svg.title: Toolbox
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C#, SQL, Solidity, Java. Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Playwright PDFs. Backend: FastAPI, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Node.js, Express, Prisma, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic v2, OpenAPI, Background workers. AI: Claude API, Gemini API, Retrieval over structured corpora, Structured output, Evaluation sets, scikit-learn. Payments: Stripe, Shopify webhooks, Shopify GraphQL Admin API, Idempotency keys, Webhook signature checks, Transactional inbox. Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Alembic, Schema design, Query optimisation. Infrastructure: Docker, GitHub Actions, Nginx, AWS EC2/RDS/S3, Cloudflare, Linux, DigitalOcean, Render. Security: Clerk, JWT, RBAC, Rate limiting, Runtime secret injection, Audit logging. Testing: xUnit, Testcontainers, pytest, schemathesis, Locust, Playwright, ruff and mypy in CI
